macro_context: Risk-off tape into the open: US-Iran tensions escalated over the weekend, Brent crude jumped 3% above $78/bbl, the rupee slipped 37 paise to 95.70/USD, and gold/silver fell as rising oil revived rate-hike bets. Asian markets (Kospi, Nikkei) opened lower on the same tensions. The Fed flagged tariffs, energy costs and AI capex as fresh inflation drivers, with US CPI data and big-bank earnings due this week - a hawkish setup ahead of India's own Q1 FY27 earnings season, which kicks off this week with 140+ companies reporting including RIL, HDFC Bank, ICICI Bank, Axis Bank and the major IT names. Nifty IT was already under pressure pre-results.
